full_name.description: The person's own full name, as a letterhead field -- not a section of ordinary CV content.
examples: Dr Camilla Hadi Chaudhary
include: The candidate's own name, only if content genuinely needs correcting to be the name field.
exclude: Any regular CV content -- this is almost never a correct destination outside of fixing a misextracted name.

biography.description: A short written paragraph describing who the person is professionally -- their role, expertise, and research/teaching focus in prose, not bullet facts.
examples: Dr Camilla holds a PhD in Education from the University of Cambridge and researches educational inclusion and equity.
Marketing Manager with 9+ years of experience across agencies and in-house roles.
include: A self-description paragraph already written in the CV (a 'Profile'/'Objective'/'Summary' section).
exclude: A bare skill or trait with no sentence around it ("Fluent in English.") -- too short to be a biography.
A single fact like a degree title with no narrative -- belongs in Qualifications instead.

qualifications.description: Academic degrees, professional certifications, and formal education -- what the person studied, where, and when.
examples: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Education, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom
Google Analytics Certified
Bachelor of Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering
include: Degrees, diplomas, certifications, formal training courses with a credential.
exclude: A short course or training that isn't a credential and reads more like a skill -- consider Skills instead.
Membership of a professional body -- that belongs in Professional Association Memberships instead.

associations.description: Membership in professional bodies, societies, and fellowships -- being a member/fellow of an organisation, not a role performed for it.
examples: Member, British Association of International and Comparative Education (BAICE)
Fellow, Higher Education Academy
include: Membership status in a named professional body or society.
exclude: An active role performed within a body (chairing a committee, editing its journal) -- those belong under Committees or Editorial Roles instead, since the fact being reported is the role, not the membership.

present_employment.description: The person's current job at Middlesex University -- a role with no stated end date, at MDX specifically.
examples: Senior Lecturer, International and Comparative Education, Middlesex University Dubai (2023 - Present)
include: A current, ongoing role specifically at Middlesex University.
exclude: A current role at any OTHER employer -- that is Previous Employment even if it is still ongoing, since this section is MDX-specific.

previous_employment.description: Any past role, including a past MDX role that has ended, and any role -- past or present -- at an employer other than Middlesex University.
examples: Marketing Manager, Byezzy Tech, Dubai, UAE (2023 - 2025)
Consultant, Oxford Policy Management, Oxford, United Kingdom (2024 - 2026)
include: Job title, employer, and dates for any past or non-MDX role.
exclude: A CURRENT role at Middlesex University specifically -- that belongs in Present Employment instead.

teaching_learning.description: Teaching responsibilities, module leadership, curriculum development, and student supervision -- the act of teaching or building teaching materials.
examples: Taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses in comparative education.
Developed curriculum for a new module on inclusive education.
Supervised five PhD students to completion.
include: Direct teaching, module/curriculum design, and supervising students.
exclude: A research publication about teaching methods -- that belongs in Publications, not Teaching, since the fact being reported is a publication, not a teaching activity.

committees.description: Membership on an internal or external committee, advisory group, working group, task force, or board -- a governance or advisory seat, not an editorial or academic-leadership one.
examples: Member, Advisory Group, Parliamentarians Caucus
Member, Faculty Research Ethics Committee
include: Sitting on a named committee, advisory board, working group, or task force.
exclude: Founding or leading an initiative -- that is Academic Leadership, which outranks a plain committee seat.
Reviewing or editing for a journal -- that is Editorial Roles.

academic_leadership.description: Founding, directing, or leading an academic initiative, network, programme, or executive-level role -- leadership specifically, not ordinary committee membership.
examples: Co-founder and Convenor, SAARE Network
Head of Centre for Academic Success
Member, Executive Committee, BAICE
include: Founding/directing/leading a group, programme, network, or serving on an EXECUTIVE committee/board (as opposed to an ordinary advisory one).
exclude: An ordinary (non-executive) committee seat with no leadership component -- that is Committees instead.

knowledge_exchange.description: Public engagement and professional-practice activity outside teaching and formal committee work -- running or speaking at events, outreach, media appearances.
examples: Co-convenor, CASES Seminar Series
Keynote speaker, International Conference on Education Policy
Participant, Mukalma TV programme
include: Organising or speaking at seminars/workshops/conferences run as outreach, public talks, media appearances, community/industry engagement.
exclude: A conference PAPER or presentation that is a research output -- that belongs in Publications (this template files conference papers as research outputs, not as knowledge exchange).

awards.description: Prizes, honours, scholarships, and formal recognitions received by the person.
examples: Recipient of the Top 6% of Nevada Sales Award, 2015
Dean's List, 2019
include: A named prize, honour, scholarship, or formal recognition.
exclude: A certification or credential -- those belong in Qualifications even if they sound prestigious.

centres_of_excellence.description: The person's contribution to a named MDX centre of excellence or research lab -- affiliation with or contribution to such a centre specifically.
examples: Member, Centre for Academic Success, Middlesex University Dubai
include: Named contribution to or role within a specific research centre or lab at Middlesex University.
exclude: A generic research group not branded as an MDX centre -- consider Academic Leadership or Previous/Present Employment instead depending on context.

grants.description: Research funding, grants received, and consultancy projects -- money awarded for research or paid consultancy work performed.
examples: Received a research grant from the national council, 2024-2026.
Consultant, Oxford Policy Management -- FCDO-funded research consortium.
include: A funded research project, grant received, or consultancy engagement with a named funder or client.
exclude: An unfunded research project with no grant or client attached -- that is more likely Publications or Knowledge Exchange depending on its nature.

editorial_roles.description: Editorial, peer-review, and examiner roles for journals or publications -- being an editor, editorial board member, reviewer, or external examiner.
examples: Associate Editor, Cambridge Journal of Education
Reviewer, Comparative Education Review
External Examiner, MPhil in Architecture
include: Any editor/editorial-board/reviewer/external-examiner role for a journal, publisher, or degree programme.
exclude: Membership of the journal's parent professional body with no editorial role -- that is Professional Association Memberships instead.

publications.description: The person's own research outputs -- journal articles, books, book chapters, conference papers and presentations, and (for creative/design disciplines) exhibited practice outputs.
examples: Chaudhary, C. (2024). Educational inclusion and equity. Cambridge Journal of Education.
Keynote paper presented at the International Conference on Comparative Education, 2025.
Selected Practice Outputs: solo exhibition, Dubai Design Week, 2024.
include: Journal articles, books, book chapters, conference papers/presentations, media/blog research outputs, and creative/practice-based research outputs.
exclude: A talk given as public outreach with no research-output character -- that is Knowledge Exchange instead.

profiles_links.description: Scholarly identifiers and professional profile links -- ORCID, Scopus, Google Scholar, LinkedIn, ResearchGate, personal/centre websites.
examples: LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/example
include: A named identifier or URL to a professional/scholarly profile.
exclude: A citation or publication URL that is really a research output -- that belongs in Publications, not here.

skills.description: Not one of the 20 official MDX sections, but a real, labelled section for technical or soft skills -- tools, software, and competencies, stated as a short phrase, not a sentence.
examples: Performance marketing
Zoho CRM
Team leadership
include: A short skill, tool, or competency phrase.
exclude: A full sentence describing an accomplishment or responsibility -- that is a job responsibility and belongs in Previous/Present Employment instead.

language_proficiency.description: Not one of the 20 official MDX sections, but a real, labelled section for languages the person speaks.
examples: English
Malayalam (native)
include: A named language, optionally with a proficiency level.
exclude: Anything that isn't a language name.
